root_cause: The supplied file contains a bare OAuth client ID, so SCOS cannot know whether the client is Desktop or Web or which redirect URI is authorized. A guessed loopback redirect caused Google error 400 redirect_uri_mismatch.
required_human_action: Open Google Cloud Console -> Google Auth Platform -> Clients
Create or select an OAuth client whose Application type is Desktop app
Place the downloaded JSON on the Windows machine
Run scripts/scos_youtube_oauth.py with --client-file pointing to that JSON
